import copy,hashlib,json,pathlib,sys
from fractions import Fraction

def require(condition,message):
    if not condition:raise ValueError(message)

def read(path):return json.loads(path.read_text())
def rational(value):return Fraction(*value) if isinstance(value,list) else Fraction(str(value))
score_path,reference_path,candidate_path,source_path,output=map(pathlib.Path,sys.argv[1:])
score,reference,candidate=map(read,(score_path,reference_path,candidate_path))
require(hashlib.sha256(score_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='888c0e3f69eae5cc1bf45f78e55dffbd3a3bf40716943e03f9cb6878a20f97bd','Preserved complete reduction changed')
require(hashlib.sha256(source_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='8bf2fa73160461e13ace1609393879e12929ada5241e80f397cd3c0e4dfe429d','Pinned source MIDI changed')
require((candidate['sidCount'],candidate['sidModel'],candidate['clock'])==(1,'MOS8580','pal'),'Keep the established native target')
expected=dict(lead=dict(adsr='0a49'),bass=dict(adsr='0999',pulse=[['85','00','00'],['1d','29','00'],['0f','d7','00'],['0f','29','00'],dict(jump=2)],filter=[]))
restored=copy.deepcopy(candidate)
for role,fields in expected.items():
    for field,value in fields.items():
        require(candidate['instruments'][role][field]==value,'Master palette does not implement the selected '+role+' '+field)
        restored['instruments'][role][field]=copy.deepcopy(reference['instruments'][role][field])
require(restored==reference,'Only the approved lead ADSR and bass ADSR/PWM/filter may change')
require([voice['name'] for voice in score['voices']]==['melody','harmony','bass'],'Established physical roles changed')
start,end=map(Fraction,(64,96))
selected=copy.deepcopy(score)
selected.pop('sections',None)
selected['totalBeats']=float(end-start)
selected['provenance']=dict((key,value) for key,value in score['provenance'].items() if key!='reduction')
selected['provenance']['masterPaletteTrial']=dict(arrangedWindowBeats=[64,96],sourceWindowBeats=[68,100],fullReducedScoreSha256=hashlib.sha256(score_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
for before,after in zip(score['voices'],selected['voices']):
    require(not any(rational(event['startBeat'])<start<rational(event['startBeat'])+rational(event['durationBeats']) for event in before['events']),'A note crosses the excerpt entrance')
    after['events']=[]
    for event in before['events']:
        onset,duration=map(rational,(event['startBeat'],event['durationBeats']))
        if start<=onset<end:
            require(onset+duration<=end,'A note crosses the excerpt ending')
            after['events'].append(dict(event,startBeat=float(onset-start)))
require(not selected['voices'][1]['events'],'Harmony voice must remain vacant; no percussion in this palette trial')
report=dict(schemaVersion=1,arrangedWindowBeats=[64,96],sourceWindowBeats=[68,100],sourceSha256=score['provenance']['sourceSha256'],fullReducedScoreSha256=hashlib.sha256(score_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),changedInstrumentFields=expected,sourcePitchesDurationsAndOnsetsPreserved=True,tonalNoteCounts=[len(voice['events']) for voice in selected['voices']],transpositionSemitones=0,percussionAdded=False,scope='One coherent lead-and-bass palette on the existing hook, not a full arrangement revision or exact source-driver reconstruction.')
output.mkdir()
for name,value in (('score.json',selected),('adaptation.json',report)):
    (output/name).write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+chr(10))
for name,palette in (('reference.json',reference),('candidate.json',candidate)):
    palette=copy.deepcopy(palette)
    palette['sections']=[dict(name='Existing hook and bass; no percussion',startBeat=0,endBeat=32,voices=dict(melody='lead',harmony='harmony',bass='bass'))]
    palette['score']='score.json'
    (output/name).write_text(json.dumps(palette,indent=2)+chr(10))

import hashlib,json,math,pathlib,sys
from audio_comparison import Pcm16,measure_pcm,read_pcm16
def require(condition,message):
    if not condition: raise ValueError(message)
reports=[]
for label,manifest_path,wav_path in zip(('reference','candidate'),sys.argv[1:3],sys.argv[3:5]):
    manifest_bytes=pathlib.Path(manifest_path).read_bytes()
    manifest=json.loads(manifest_bytes)
    stop_tick,rate=manifest['stopTick'],manifest['ticksPerSecond']
    require(type(stop_tick) is int and stop_tick>0 and type(rate) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(rate) and rate>0 and manifest['stopVolumeClearTick']==stop_tick,'Invalid native stop/volume-clear timing')
    stop=stop_tick/rate
    audio=read_pcm16(wav_path)
    first,last=(round((stop-offset)*audio.sample_rate) for offset in (0.5,0.1))
    require(audio.channels==manifest['sidCount'] and 0<=first<last<=audio.frames and last/audio.sample_rate<stop,'Pre-stop release window must fit the declared audio before volume clear')
    samples=audio.samples[first*audio.channels:last*audio.channels]
    metrics=measure_pcm(Pcm16(audio.sample_rate,audio.channels,last-first,samples,''))
    require(all(channel['acRms']<=16 for channel in metrics['perChannel']),label+' release exceeds 16 PCM16 AC RMS before volume clear')
    if sys.byteorder!='little': samples.byteswap()
    reports.append(dict(label=label,manifestSha256=hashlib.sha256(manifest_bytes).hexdigest(),audioSha256=audio.sha256,stopTick=stop_tick,stopVolumeClearTick=manifest['stopVolumeClearTick'],ticksPerSecond=rate,stopSeconds=stop,requestedWindowSeconds=[stop-0.5,stop-0.1],window=dict(startFrame=first,endFrame=last,startSeconds=first/audio.sample_rate,endSeconds=last/audio.sample_rate,pcm16LeSha256=hashlib.sha256(samples.tobytes()).hexdigest(),metrics=metrics)))
pathlib.Path(sys.argv[5]).write_text(json.dumps(dict(schemaVersion=1,maxPerChannelAcRms=16,scope='Rendered decay must settle in the declared window before native volume clear; musical ending acceptance remains open.',renders=reports),indent=2)+chr(10))

import hashlib,json,pathlib,sys,wave
from audio_comparison import Pcm16,measure_pcm,read_pcm16
source_path,output=map(pathlib.Path,sys.argv[1:]);audio=read_pcm16(source_path)
reports=[]
for name,start,end in (('huelsbeck-lead-and-beat-9.5-20s.wav',9.5,20),('huelsbeck-support-28-44s.wav',28,44),('huelsbeck-high-phrase-56-66s.wav',56,66)):
    first,last=(round(value*audio.sample_rate) for value in (start,end))
    if not 0<=first<last<=audio.frames:raise ValueError('Source context is outside the rendered stream')
    samples=audio.samples[first*audio.channels:last*audio.channels]
    metrics=measure_pcm(Pcm16(audio.sample_rate,audio.channels,last-first,samples,''))
    if metrics['acRms']<=1 or metrics['clippedSamples']:raise ValueError('Source context has an unhealthy signal')
    if sys.byteorder!='little':samples.byteswap()
    data=samples.tobytes()
    path=output/name
    with path.open('xb') as stream:
        with wave.open(stream,'wb') as wav:
            wav.setparams((audio.channels,2,audio.sample_rate,0,'NONE','not compressed'));wav.writeframes(data)
    reports.append(dict(filename=name,sourceWindowSeconds=[start,end],gain=1,sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),metrics=metrics))
(output/'source-contexts.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(schemaVersion=1,sourceWavSha256=audio.sha256,clock='PAL',sidModel='MOS6581',subtune=1,clips=reports,scope='Original Hulsbeck reference in its own key, tempo, form and arrangement; timbral/ensemble context, not same-score A/B fidelity.'),indent=2)+chr(10))

import hashlib,json,math,pathlib,sys
from audio_comparison import read_pcm16

def require(condition,message):
    if not condition:raise ValueError(message)

a,b=map(read_pcm16,sys.argv[1:3])
require((a.sample_rate,a.channels,a.frames)==(b.sample_rate,b.channels,b.frames),'Full render formats and lengths differ')
reports=[]
for label,report_path in zip(('lead-and-bass-palette',),sys.argv[3:4]):
    report=json.loads(pathlib.Path(report_path).read_text())
    require(report['normalization'] is False and all(x['gain']==1 and x['gainDb']==0 for x in report['inputs']),'Both comparison sides must retain unity gain')
    require([x['sha256'] for x in report['inputs']]==[a.sha256,b.sha256],'Comparison must use these exact full renders in baseline/candidate order')
    first,last=(report['window'][key]*a.channels for key in ('startFrame','endFrame'))
    delta=[y-x for x,y in zip(a.samples[first:last],b.samples[first:last])]
    changed=sum(x!=0 for x in delta)
    require(changed>0,'The submitted role pair has no signal change')
    mean=sum(delta)/len(delta)
    rms=math.sqrt(sum(x*x for x in delta)/len(delta))
    reports.append(dict(label=label,window=report['window'],changedSamples=changed,totalSamples=len(delta),deltaRms=rms,deltaAcRms=math.sqrt(max(0,rms*rms-mean*mean)),comparisonSha256=report['comparison']['sha256'],inputGains=[x['gain'] for x in report['inputs']]))
pathlib.Path(sys.argv[4]).write_text(json.dumps(dict(schemaVersion=1,referenceSha256=a.sha256,candidateSha256=b.sha256,comparisons=reports,scope='Confirms nonidentical PCM from the exact submitted unity-gain pair; this does not establish audibility, preference or musical usefulness.'),indent=2)+chr(10))
